name: SQE1 (Solicitors Qualifying Examination, Stage 1) — Functioning Legal Knowledge
material_vintage: SRA SQE1 Assessment Specification, FLK1 and FLK2 content-statement pages, fetched live on 2026-09-22 from sqe.sra.org.uk/assessments/sqe1-assessments/sqe1-specification/flk1 and /flk2 and itemised in full -- every subject heading and sub-heading on both pages is represented by at least one item id below, using the SRA's own sub-heading wording. Assessment mechanics (170 single-best-answer questions per paper across two 2 hour 33 minute sessions of 85 questions each, five answer options, criterion-referenced pass-mark setting rather than a fixed percentage) carried over unchanged from the prior build's rubric.json, which recorded these as checked against the SRA's own pages on 2026-09-17 (including the correction that the SRA specifies 170 questions per paper, not 180). Item ids are this build's own stable scheme (subject-code.number, e.g. BLP.1, DR.1, CON.1), since the SRA's content pages use nested headings rather than a single running numbering scheme across the whole page.
level_source: standalone: the SRA publishes no RQF/FHEQ level for the SQE (a professional licensing assessment); no level recorded. Made standalone by the library owner on 2026-09-26.
